title: FederationCryptoProfile v0
description: Gates the crypto of the Merkle-log P2P federation layer (SSB/Hypercore/IPFS-style signed append-only logs). Two surfaces: the CONTENT HASH (Merkle CIDs) and the feed SIGNATURE. Aligned to the v4 suite selector (§13.4): mode stays for back-compat, suite (absent => standard->0, fips->1) must be consistent. suite>=1 requires a FIPS hash (SHA-2/3; BLAKE refused) + a FIPS 186-5 signature (ECDSA/RSA/EdDSA) + the approved-mode assertions (sign the canonical bytes only, self-tests). suite 2 (CNSA 2.0) requires SHA-384/512 and an ML-DSA-87 signature — an Ed25519/ECDSA feed claiming suite 2 is refused (under-assured).

suite.description: v4 §13.4 suite selector; absent => derived from mode.

contentAddressing.description: informational: the federation scheme this profile secures. The hash/signature — not the scheme — is what the suite gates.
